name: Alumnium
description: AI layer for end-to-end tests that adds natural-language actions and checks on top of existing test drivers, plus an MCP server.
whatItDoes: Lets test engineers write steps and assertions in plain language while keeping their current test framework. It works with web and mobile drivers and can also be attached to a coding agent to exercise an application.
howItWorks: A wrapper object takes an existing driver session, sends the accessibility tree and optionally screenshots to a model, and converts the answer into driver commands or a verdict on an assertion. Packages exist for Python, TypeScript and Java, and a standalone binary runs as an MCP server.
